Yumfu 1.4.1 Changelog

YumFu 1.3.0 Changelog

- Introduced Deep Narrative Engine (DNE) with mandatory branching structures, hidden stats, advanced consequence types, and NPC memory across all game worlds.
- Added extensive content and infrastructure for the new "F15 Down" world, including guides, design docs, and world data.
- Expanded documentation with new guides on character creation and internal narrative rules (see: DEEP_NARRATIVE_ENGINE.md).
- Enhanced narrative strictness: All user choices now branch the story (no dead ends); each adventure must support at least 30 decision nodes and 6 unique endings per world.
- Increased image generation coverage with clear triggering rules for portraits, locations, emotional twists, and all endings.
- Updated save/load requirements, clarified AI agent instructions, and improved organization of world and gameplay data.
MAJOR UPDATE: Every game turn now REQUIRES image generation (visual novel mode). Only meta commands (status/help/save) skip images. Ensures complete storybook logs and consistent immersion.
Add detailed /yumfu continue workflow documentation. AI now properly checks all save files and lists them for user selection.
Add response length guidelines (150-300 words) to prevent lazy or overly verbose replies. Prevents small models from being too brief or too wordy.
Restore mandatory features: Images and logging are core game features (not optional). Removed privacy opt-out controls.
Privacy policy alignment: Removed mandatory language (MUST/CRITICAL/ALWAYS), added explicit privacy controls (YUMFU_NO_LOGGING, YUMFU_NO_IMAGES), aligned SKILL.md with PRIVACY.md documentation
Privacy alignment fixes
Security fixes: Removed subprocess.run(), use OpenClaw exec tool instead

🔒 Privacy Release v1.0.2

Privacy Improvements (ClawHub feedback):
- Add PRIVACY.md - Comprehensive privacy policy
- Make session logging optional (YUMFU_NO_LOGGING=1)
- Make AI images optional (YUMFU_NO_IMAGES=1)
- Clarify GEMINI_API_KEY is optional (not required)
- Add privacy controls documentation
- Add privacy badge to README

Privacy Levels:
- Max Privacy: No external calls, no logging
- Balanced: Images only, no logging  
- Full: Images + storybook logs

Impact:
- ✅ Addresses privacy transparency concerns
- ✅ Users control data collection
- ✅ Clear opt-out mechanisms
- ✅ Zero breaking changes
